```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(viridis)
library(tidyverse)
library(qs)
library(pryr)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(shinyjs)
library(ggthemes)
library(data.table)
library(corrplot)

ndGain <- readRDS("/Users/student/Desktop/Data+/climate_plus_summer_2025/June16Dashboard/data/filteredNDGainData copy.rds")
average_country <- readRDS("/Users/student/Desktop/Data+/climate_plus_summer_2025/June16Dashboard/data/country_centroids_with_data.rds")

```

Let's only look at ND Gain for 2020 for now to compare.

```{r}

ndGain2020 <- ndGain %>%
  filter(Year == 2020)

```


```{r}

ndGainVarNames <- names(ndGain)[4:19]
ndGainVarNames <- c("ISO3", ndGainVarNames)

inequityVarNames <- names(average_country)[5:24]
inequityVarNames <- c("iso_a3", inequityVarNames)


varNames <- c(ndGainVarNames,inequityVarNames)
ndGainFiltered <- ndGain2020[, ndGainVarNames]
inequityFiltered <- average_country[, inequityVarNames]
inequityFiltered <- inequityFiltered %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

```

Make joined dataset, this is for 2020

```{r}

datajoined <- left_join(ndGainFiltered, inequityFiltered, by = c("ISO3" = "iso_a3"))
varNames <- setdiff(varNames, "iso_a3")
varNames <- setdiff(varNames, "COUNTRY")

data <- datajoined[varNames]
data <- datajoined[2:33]

```

Make a correlation matrix

```{r}



cor_matrix <- cor(data, use = "complete.obs")
corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "color", type = "upper", tl.cex = 0.8, 
         title = "Correlation Matrix for World")

print(cor_matrix)

```

```{r}
# Make sure your data is assigned
average_country_nogeo <- data

# Create output folder for plots
dir.create("plots", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Get all column names
cols <- names(average_country_nogeo)

# Loop through unique numeric column pairs
for (i in seq_along(cols)) {
  for (j in seq_along(cols)) {
    if (i >= j) next  # skip self-pairs and duplicates

    col1 <- cols[i]
    col2 <- cols[j]

    x <- average_country_nogeo[[col1]]
    y <- average_country_nogeo[[col2]]

    if (is.numeric(x) && is.numeric(y)) {
      spr_corr <- suppressWarnings(cor(x, y, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"))
      pear_corr <- suppressWarnings(cor(x, y, method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs"))

      if (!is.na(spr_corr) && !is.na(pear_corr)) {
        if ((abs(spr_corr) > 0.6 && abs(spr_corr) != 1) || 
            (abs(pear_corr) > 0.6&& abs(pear_corr) != 1)) {

          # Create filename-safe versions of the column names
          filename <- paste0(
            "plots/plot_",
            gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "_", col1),
            "_vs_",
            gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "_", col2),
            ".png"
          )

          # Save the plot
          png(filename, width = 800, height = 600)
          plot(x, y,
               xlab = col1,
               ylab = col2,
               main = paste0("Spearman: ", round(spr_corr, 4), 
                             " | Pearson: ", round(pear_corr, 4)))
          dev.off()
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```
